subject.title: feat: add skill allowlist merge config

question: Should OpenClaw accept `skillsMerge: { add, remove }` as the canonical public config shape for agent and Telegram topic skill allowlist composition?
rationale: This is a new compatibility- and security-sensitive config surface layered on top of an intentionally shipped replacement contract, so maintainers must choose the permanent API shape and semantics before merge.

options.title: Sponsor `skillsMerge` With Repairs
options.body: Accept the add/remove direction, then require normalized-empty hardening, docs/help/labels, conflict resolution, and refreshed proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For Config Design
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue as the decision venue if maintainers want a different shape such as a mode selector or broader channel contract.

options.title: Decline Core Surface
options.body: Close or redirect the PR if maintainers decide skill delta composition should not become a core config contract now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor `skillsMerge` With Repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the add/remove direction, then require normalized-empty hardening, docs/help/labels, conflict resolution, and refreshed proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged replacement-semantics contract that this PR extends, making them the strongest history-backed owner for the product/API choice.
